entries.en: to pay back, to return (money owed).

entries.zh: 交付（所托、所订之物）；出脱货物。
entries.en: to deliver / hand over (what was entrusted or ordered); to dispose of goods.
entries.notes: 汉字「销」与西语 dar lo que encomendaron 仅部分相合，取商贸「交付、出脱」义。

entries.zh: 注销票单；把票据交回原下令人。
entries.en: to cancel / return an order slip to the person who issued it.
entries.notes: 「销票」为动宾复合，西语 boluer a el que lo mandó 按马尼拉票据语境推得。

entries.zh: 注销并退还委令（将命令文书交回下令人）。
entries.en: to cancel and return a warrant / written order to the person who issued it.
entries.notes: 第二字候选「拴／挲」皆与该栏音写不合，无法判定；仅据「销」与西语 mandamiento 推定。

entries.en: to turn back, to return the way one came.
entries.notes: 闽南语栏残（T99），据汉字「到」、官话对音及西语 boluer al revés 推定。

entries.en: (of a ship) to turn back, to put back.
to turn the head (round).
entries.notes: 闽南语栏夹抄西语 la cabeça，惟汉字与官话对音相符，义可定。

entries.en: to go back, to turn back and go.
entries.notes: 西语「air」疑为「a ir」之残，汉字「到去」与官话对音相符。

entries.en: to come back, to return.
to turn to the reverse side, to turn over (from one face to the other).
entries.notes: 西语栏残乱，疑读 al envés…cada lado；取「转向另一面」义。

entries.en: to keep turning (it) over and over, to give turn after turn.
entries.notes: 第二字有「莲／连」之疑，音写指向「连」，取「连转」＝连续翻转。

entries.en: to turn back and walk, to walk back.
entries.notes: 西语栏残乱，然汉字、闽南语、官话三栏一致指「折回而行」。

entries.en: to flow backwards; (of water or tide) to turn.
entries.notes: 官话对音栏残；西语 la aguia 疑为 agua 之误，与「到流」相合。

entries.en: to do (it) again, to redo.
to turn (the head) to another side; to turn over.
to turn the head round / over.

entries.zh: 翻身；整个人转向另一侧。
entries.en: to turn the whole body round, to turn about (as in dancing).
to turn the head from side to side.
entries.notes: 第二字有「莲／薛」之疑，音写指向「连／莲」，取「连转」。

entries.zh: 转回来；回身（边看边往回转）。
entries.en: to turn back (looking back), to turn round.
to return, to repay (a debt).
entries.notes: 汉字仅「回」，闽南语栏次二字未详，义据西语 pagando la deuda 定为偿还。

entries.en: to return, to come back.
to return, to go back (to one's place).
to reverse, to go back on (what was said).
entries.notes: 西语栏残乱，据汉字「反」与官话对音取「翻悔、推翻前言」义。
